hook.name: GweiFeeHook
hook.description: The shared Uniswap v4 hook for the gwei.fun token launchpad. On every swap it takes a fee in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta — composed of a platform fee plus a per-pool creator tax with an optional linearly-decaying anti-snipe rate — and splits the proceeds between the pool creator and a protocol buyback vault, accumulating them as ERC-6909 claims redeemable lazily.
